ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels (distal regions) to low-intensity black pixels (medial and leading edge regions).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the distal third of both the left and right lobes. A low-intensity black central region extends from the fluke base to the median notch and along the entire leading edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 55 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of 1:4 relative to the central fluke mass.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrations observed along the entire trailing edge; frequency increases distally with peak-to-valley pixel amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave sweep from the median notch transitioning to a convex curve toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, dark, roughly circular pixel clusters detected at the lateral margin of the left lobe's white pigment region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct dark, unaligned linear rake marks on the high-intensity region of the right lobe; one prominent vertical linear disruption on the high-intensity region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Healed rake marks across distal white regions; slight irregular truncation or notch at the extreme distal tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: High-frequency 'salt-and-pepper' mottling at the pigment transition zones between the black medial region and white distal lobes.
